citation: Altun, Bleda & Trindle, "Hydrogen Bonding in 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide and related isomers", Molecules 26, 2623 (2021), doi:10.3390/molecules26092623
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only; SI coordinates copied unchanged
topic: Conformer THREE of 3-hydroxy-2-butenamide is the enol in which the hydroxyl H has been rotated away, so that the hydroxyl O and the amide carbonyl O face each other without a hydrogen between them.

facts.text: QTAIM finds a bond path between the two oxygen atoms, with a bond critical point of appreciable density and a positive Laplacian.
The non-covalent-interaction (reduced density gradient) isosurface between the two oxygens is green, i.e. repulsive.
Its O-H stretching frequency is 3836 cm^-1, like O-H groups that take part in no hydrogen bond (3842 and 3850 cm^-1); the strongly hydrogen-bonded conformer TWO has 3087 cm^-1.
Its C-C=C bend, used as a surrogate for the ring-closing stretch, is the lowest of all conformers (178 cm^-1, against 242-247 cm^-1 in hydrogen-bonded ones).

ask: Which interpretation of the O···O contact in THREE is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: No hydrogen bond: the O···O contact is repulsive, and a bond path with a critical point is not enough on its own to establish a hydrogen bond.
hypotheses.locator: AIM and NCI sections: THREE has a repulsive O···O interaction despite the density at the BCP
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: A weak O-H···O hydrogen bond, proved by the bond path and its critical point.
hypotheses.reason: NCI 为排斥，且 O–H 伸缩没有红移，键径本身不能证明氢键。

hypotheses.text: A strong hydrogen bond, since the density at the critical point is appreciable.
hypotheses.locator: NCI section; OH mode; CCC bend
hypotheses.reason: 没有红移、成环振动最软，与强氢键的预期全部相反。

hypotheses.locator: AIM section: positive Laplacian = closed-shell interaction
hypotheses.reason: 拉普拉斯量为正，表明是闭壳层相互作用，不是共价作用。

scale.definition: 两个 O 之间的距离（约 0.26 nm）
